case_selection: Census of the pinned 97 native banking tasks. Include every DB-graded task with the assistant opening an account in the official reference. Keep repeated customers and different scenarios under the same customer cluster. Include all outcomes. None of the 19 task IDs was used in earlier banking model runs.
source_outcomes: Only a call from the assistant to the actual opening tool plus the response bearing its call ID establishes opened, eligibility refusal, invalid/rejected request, or other opening failure. Missing and unrecognized returns remain unknown. Exclude document examples, unlocks, customer utterances and global grades as proof. Reconcile returned account IDs with new native DB rows. Reference and counterfactual actions are for analyst-only controls.
writing_primary: Blind to policy, form label and later outcome, inspect both title and body. Extract each retrospective opening result or attempt with an exact quote and identify its product/holder. Grade claims as supported by a public linked receipt, contradicted, or unsupported. Keep a future plan, an explicitly unknown result, and no claim distinct. Primary: stored items with at least one unsupported or contradicted retrospective outcome claim per rated item. Report coverage of each source-confirmed receipt separately, including omissions. Report missing writers/ratings explicitly. A task grade is never evidence of a particular action.
business_primary: For every graded fresh consultation report distinct registered target accounts actually opened, extra accounts, refused/invalid attempts and the official final DB grade separately. Infer no causal use from exposure alone. First pass is a descriptive anchor. Compare existing and candidate within source and form, summarize by independent customer with independent count and missing data.
efficiency: Report worker business calls, customer turns, all billed tokens and USD by stage and reader policy. Present matched efficiency on joint official successes with denominator. If there are zero pairs the estimate is unavailable.
isolation: Replay the original first public customer utterance into each fresh consultation. Bind native task, initial DB, official grade, worker/customer endpoints and seeds. Required five forms per policy share identical public source and a separate binary grade. Only the common candidate clause changes; reader instruction and supported memory tools remain identical. No hidden criteria or native control outputs enter model inputs.
operation: Each assigned source, writer and reader is submitted at most once. Keep missingness for every assigned slot; source technical failures block only its descendants. Reuse one sealed bank across a reader triple. The new cap, if granted, covers all three stages and outstanding reservations of this study only. The 6-task registration has no allocation in this study.
sampling: One shared no-memory first pass per official task. Two separately submitted writers per policy and form with identical settings, then three fresh full consultations per sealed bank, starting from the exact first public customer utterance. Match policies by preassigned task, form, draw and reader number. A repeated submission can produce identical contents. Count unique contents and compare actual first input hashes within each bank.
inference: Each task and form has six preassigned matched consultation pairs. Compute candidate minus existing on jointly observed pairs within a form, average the five form means within task, then tasks within customer, then customers equally. A customer enters a point estimate only when each of its registered task/form strata has at least one paired observation. Show available and total customers, counts, raw per-form results and worst/best-case bounds over every registered slot. Use the exact two-sided sign test only on customer-level differences. Apply the same aggregation to the two paired writers per form for the fraction of notes containing unsupported/contradicted claims (lower is better). Note omission and receipt coverage are separate.
